name: X-Ray
description: Amazon-style X-Ray for movies and shows: who is in the current scene (faces, plus voices for cartoons and costumed characters) and the song that is playing.
overview: Who is on screen, and what is playing.

## X-Ray Plugin v1.3.1.0

### Installation
1. In Jellyfin Dashboard → Plugins → Repositories → Add
2. Add this URL:
   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahass-thedev/Jellyfin-Xray/main/manifest.json
   ```
3. Go to Catalogue → X-Ray → Install

### Sidecar setup (required)
The plugin requires the Python face recognition sidecar.
See README.md for setup instructions.
